fields.label: Watches For
fields.options:
Day Not Started
No Order All Day
Coverage Below Target
Collection Overdue In Hand
Geo Fence Breaches
fields.description: Which of the five exceptions this rule is an instance of. The condition itself lives in services/alerts.py - a rule sets the threshold and who hears about it, not what is being measured. A site that could write its own condition here would be a site where nobody can say what an alert means.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Read in whatever unit the exception implies: a percentage for coverage, rupees for cash in hand, a count for geo-fence breaches. Deliberately not typed per exception - a Currency field showing 60 for a coverage rule would be worse than a plain number.

fields.label: Ignore Below A Base Of
fields.description: A ratio over almost nothing is noise. A rep who made two calls and converted neither is at 0% strike rate and has not yet had a day; firing on that trains everybody to ignore the alert. Zero means fire regardless.

fields.label: For This Many Days Running
fields.description: One bad day is weather. Three is a pattern. The count is of days the condition held, not of days since it first did.

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Blank means everywhere. Set it and the rule reaches this territory and everything under it.

fields.label: Designation
fields.options:
Field Rep
Senior Field Rep
Area Manager
Regional Manager
fields.description: Blank means everybody. A Select with a real empty option rather than a Link, because Frappe fills an empty Link from the session default (ADR-020).

fields.label: Sales Person
fields.description: Blank means the whole tree. Set it to watch one branch - the node and everybody below it.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Written for the person who will read it on a phone at nine in the morning. Placeholders: {rep}, {date}, {value}, {threshold}, {base}. Left blank, the exception supplies its own sentence.

fields.label: Notify Roles
fields.description: Comma separated role names. Blank tells nobody and only writes the log, which is a reasonable way to run a new rule for a week before letting it speak.

fields.label: Do Not Repeat For (days)
fields.description: A rule that fires every morning about the same unresolved thing is a rule people filter into a folder. Zero means it may fire once per occurrence, which is already once per rep per day at most.
